entries.title: Destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah
entries.correctionJustification: The city's destruction and Lot's rescue end at v29; vv30–38 are Lot's daughters and the later origins of Moab and Ammon.

entries.title: Dinah and the events at Shechem
Jacob blesses his sons
entries.correctionJustification: The blessings of Jacob's sons conclude in v28; vv29–32 contain burial instructions and Jacob's death.

entries.title: Deaths of Jacob and Joseph
entries.correctionJustification: Jacob's death and burial and Joseph's death occur at distinct points. Genesis 50:15–21 is a separate reconciliation episode, not one death scene.

entries.correctionJustification: The Queen of Sheba departs in v13; the succeeding account from v14 concerns Solomon's wealth.

entries.title: Solomon's apostasy
entries.correctionJustification: Solomon's religious apostasy and divine response occupy vv1–13; from v14 the narrative turns to political adversaries.

entries.title: Elijah and the widow of Sarepta
entries.correctionJustification: Elijah and the widow at Sarepta begins with God's instruction in v8, and the multiplication ends in v16; v17 begins the separate sickness of her son.

entries.title: Elijah confronts the prophets of Baal
entries.correctionJustification: The public confrontation and triumph over Baal's prophets begin with Elijah confronting Ahab in v17 and end at v40; v41 introduces rain.
